data_custodian: NERC Environmental Data Service / National Geoscience Data Centre
dataset_title: UKGEOS Glasgow GGC01 Final Borehole Information Pack
modalities: XRF mineralogical and chemical core scans

rights.acknowledgement: Contains data supplied by permission of the Natural Environment Research Council [YEAR]
rights.reconciliation: Use the exact BGS/NGDC cited-data record for the final pack as the publisher-level terms source; preserve the data.gov.uk harvest discrepancy in the ingest receipt. Verify package manifest and file-level notices before admitting individual assets.

package_notes.main_final_pack: UKGEOSGlasgow_GGC01_Final.zip; principal mixed-format package, size not stated in source record
package_notes.intermediate_part_two_high_resolution_im: separate prior release, approximately 71 GB; not automatically part of final-pack licence/admission

benchmark_fitness.best_fit: single-borehole, within-borehole multimodal interoperability, core-wireline depth alignment, sample/interval lineage, and source/derived evidence provenance
benchmark_fitness.not_suitable_as_standalone: multi-site geological generalization, regional stratigraphic accuracy leaderboard, universal geophysical SOTA, or independent field-wide validation
benchmark_fitness.split_policy: contiguous depth-block holdouts with buffer gaps; never random-split adjacent depth samples across train and test
benchmark_fitness.independent_truth_requirement: identify measurements/logs independent of the target channel; do not use the released depth-integration product as both fitting input and independent evaluation truth

claim_boundary: This is publisher metadata for a single borehole dataset candidate. No files have been downloaded or ingested; no geotechnical observations, calibration, modelling, or physical validation is claimed.
